description: Implementation of the Sampur Kappalthurai Transmission Infrastructure Development Project
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2026-11-02 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - Approval was granted at the Cabinet meeting held on 2025 12 15, for the construction of Sampur Solar Collector 220(132)/33kV Grid Substation and for the augmentation of Kappalthurai 220(132)/33kV Grid Substation under the Sampur-Kappalthurai Transmission Infrastructure Development Project, being implemented with financial assistance of the Asian Infrastructure Investment Bank (AIIB) for strengthening the transmission system required for ensuring an optimal power system efficiency. Bids have been invited following the international competitive procurement method to select a contractor to implement the said project and 06 bids have been received for the same. The proposal made by the Minister of Energy to award the said contract to Joint Venture of Ceylex Engineering (Pvt.) Ltd and Xingneng Electric Power Construction Co. Ltd., substantially responsive lowest evaluated bidder, at a sum of USD 4.15 million, EUR 0.78 million and LKR 1,096.08 million based on the recommendation submitted by the High Level Procurement Committee after evaluating said bids, was approved by the Cabinet.
